hunks.baseline: From the moment they crossed the unnaturally powerful current of Tianling Falls and entered the territory of Donghu Stronghold, Ship-Fire Boy Mu Song’s heart had been beating faster and faster.
hunks.sol: From the moment they crossed the unnaturally powerful currents of Tianling Falls and entered Donghu Stronghold’s territory, Ship-Fire Boy Mu Song’s heart had begun to beat faster.

hunks.baseline: Mu Song’s true Master, the Seafaring King, was not a warm man, and their relationship was as dry and barren as sand.
hunks.sol: Mu Song’s true master, the Seafaring King, was not an affectionate man, and their relationship was as dry and barren as sand.

hunks.baseline: When Mu Song was young, it was Hwang Chung’s warm advice and consideration that allowed him to endure the harsh scolding and training.
hunks.sol: When Mu Song was young, it had been Hwang Chung’s warm advice and consideration that allowed him to endure his master’s harsh scolding and grueling training.

hunks.baseline: Hwang Chung was the most serious and thoughtful person in the Yangtze River Channel League.
hunks.sol: Hwang Chung was more serious and thoughtful than anyone else in the Yangtze River Channel League.

hunks.baseline: There was no way a man like him would have made the worst possible move by eliminating the Sea Serpent Society and the Dongting Fisherman in such a manner.
hunks.sol: There was no way a man like him would make the worst possible move by eliminating the Sea Serpent Society and the Dongting Fisherman in such a manner.

hunks.baseline: Because of his unshakable faith in Hwang Chung, Mu Song had chosen to come here in person.
hunks.sol: It was because of his unshakable faith in Hwang Chung that Mu Song had chosen to come here in person.

hunks.baseline: But regardless of that faith, his unease continued to grow with every passing moment.
hunks.sol: But despite that faith, his unease continued to swell with every passing moment.

hunks.baseline: The Hwang Chung he knew, the Yangtze One Saber, was thorough and cautious in everything he did. He would never neglect the stronghold’s defenses just because he trusted in Tianling Falls.
hunks.sol: The Hwang Chung he knew, the Yangtze One Saber, was thorough and cautious in everything he did. He would never neglect the stronghold’s defenses simply because Tianling Falls protected it.

hunks.baseline: If unauthorized intruders crossed Tianling Falls, they would soon see a gorge several hundred zhang long, along with countless arrowheads waiting to greet them from above.
hunks.sol: If unauthorized intruders crossed Tianling Falls, they should have been met by a gorge several hundred zhang long and countless arrowheads aimed down at them from above.

hunks.baseline: Even after they raised the Yangtze River Channel League’s flag high and beat the drums to send a signal, the surroundings remained as quiet as before.
hunks.sol: Even after they raised the Yangtze River Channel League’s flag and beat the drums to signal their arrival, the surroundings remained as quiet as before.

hunks.baseline: Mu Song’s heart pounded violently as he stared at the island shrouded in thick fog.
hunks.sol: Mu Song’s heart hammered against his ribs as he stared at the island shrouded in thick fog.

hunks.baseline: That single thought flashed through his mind. Before long, the vague unease he had felt revealed its true form.
hunks.sol: The thought flashed through his mind.
It was not long before his vague unease took shape.

hunks.baseline: At the words of the young medical apprentice Mungyeong, Mu Song turned his head—then could not finish his sentence. He swallowed hard.
hunks.sol: Mu Song turned toward the young medical apprentice Mungyeong, but the rest of his words died in his throat. He swallowed hard.

hunks.baseline: A moment later, unrest spread like wildfire among the people aboard the ships.
hunks.sol: A moment later, alarm spread like wildfire among the people aboard the ships.

hunks.baseline: Everyone present was a martial artist accustomed to blood and death. They had seen enough corpses to grow sick of them, but this time was different.
hunks.sol: Everyone present was a martial artist accustomed to blood and death. They had seen enough corpses to be sick of them, but this time was different.

hunks.baseline: This was Donghu Stronghold. At a time when the Sea Serpent Society’s key figures had been wiped out and the Dongting Fisherman was all but confirmed dead, there should have been no one in Hubei Province capable of crossing the even more violent Tianling Falls to reach this place.
hunks.sol: This was Donghu Stronghold. With the Sea Serpent Society’s key figures wiped out and the Dongting Fisherman all but confirmed dead, there should have been no one in Hubei Province capable of crossing the now even fiercer Tianling Falls to reach this place.

hunks.baseline: Amid the agitation, Mu Song, who had remained silent, forced his voice out.
hunks.sol: Amid the commotion, Mu Song forced out a strained command.

hunks.baseline: “...Pull it aboard at once. We need to identify it.”
hunks.sol: “…Pull it aboard at once. We need to identify it.”

hunks.baseline: Fire King Jeok Cheongang had been raging only moments ago. Now, he spoke in a low, settled voice as he stretched out one hand.
hunks.sol: Fire King Jeok Cheongang had been raging only moments ago. Now he spoke in a low, somber voice as he extended one hand.

hunks.baseline: Powerful internal energy shot across the distance and seized the corpse submerged in the water.
hunks.sol: A surge of powerful internal energy crossed the distance and dragged the half-submerged corpse from the water.

hunks.baseline: Whoosh—bang!
hunks.sol: Whoosh—thud!

hunks.baseline: With a heavy thud, the body landed on the deck of the fast ship.
hunks.sol: The body landed heavily on the deck of the swift ship.

hunks.baseline: Half of its upper body was gone, and its face was bloated. Mu Song’s eyes widened when he saw it.
hunks.sol: Half of its upper body was gone, and its face was bloated. Mu Song’s eyes widened the moment he saw it.

hunks.baseline: Jin Taekyung strode over to him, and Mu Song nodded dazedly at the question.
hunks.sol: Jin Taekyung strode over, and Mu Song nodded dazedly.

hunks.baseline: Donghu Stronghold ruled the Yangtze in Hubei Province. Naturally, the name and sobriquet of its Deputy Stronghold Lord—and the right-hand man of the Yangtze One Saber Hwang Chung—were widely known.
hunks.sol: Donghu Stronghold ruled the Yangtze in Hubei Province. Naturally, the name and sobriquet of its Deputy Stronghold Lord—and the right-hand man of Yangtze One Saber Hwang Chung—were widely known.

hunks.baseline: Ignoring the sighs that escaped at the name Little Tide Demon, Jin Taekyung stared at Mu Song with a stiff expression.
hunks.sol: Ignoring the gasps that followed the name Little Tide Demon, Jin Taekyung stared grimly at Mu Song.

hunks.baseline: “Deputy Stronghold Lord? Are you certain?”
hunks.sol: “The Deputy Stronghold Lord? Are you certain?”

hunks.baseline: “Without a doubt. The corpse is badly damaged, but not so badly that I can’t recognize his face.”
hunks.sol: “Without a doubt. The body is badly damaged, but not enough to keep me from recognizing his face.”

hunks.baseline: “...Damn it.”
hunks.sol: “…Damn it.”

hunks.baseline: Jin Taekyung’s face hardened. It was the same for everyone who understood what this meant.
hunks.sol: Jin Taekyung’s expression hardened. So did the faces of everyone who understood what this meant.

hunks.baseline: Even if it had been an ordinary river bandit, the event would have been ominous. But this was the Deputy Stronghold Lord of Donghu Stronghold—and a Supreme Peak master of the Yangtze River Channel League, whose name was renowned throughout Hubei Murim.
hunks.sol: The death of even an ordinary river bandit would have been ominous enough. But this was the Deputy Stronghold Lord of Donghu Stronghold, a Supreme Peak master of the Yangtze River Channel League whose name was renowned throughout Hubei Murim.

hunks.baseline: The meaning of this chain of events was obvious.
hunks.sol: What this sequence of events meant was obvious.

hunks.baseline: Jin Taekyung was the first to turn the thought that had flashed through everyone’s minds into action.
hunks.sol: Jin Taekyung was the first to act on the thought that had flashed through all their minds.

hunks.baseline: He crossed the deck at blinding speed and reached the stern of the fast ship, then thrust both arms forward with all his strength.
hunks.sol: He crossed the deck at blinding speed, reached the stern of the swift ship, and thrust both arms out with all his strength.

hunks.baseline: The Scorching Yang Qi carried by the Flame Divine Palm evaporated the river water and propelled the fast ship forward.
hunks.sol: The Scorching Yang Qi carried by the Flame Divine Palm evaporated the river water and propelled the swift ship forward.

hunks.baseline: Only then did the others recover from their shock and begin moving after him.
hunks.sol: Only then did the others recover from their shock and spring into action.

hunks.baseline: “Boatmen, get back to your positions and take hold of the oars! Every second counts!”
hunks.sol: “Boatmen, return to your positions and take up the oars! Every second counts!”

hunks.baseline: “Tell the other ships! Send them a signal at once!”
hunks.sol: “Tell the other ships! Send the signal at once!”

hunks.baseline: Amid the confusion, Mu Song raised his head, feeling his own heart pounding louder and more violently than the drums echoing around him.
hunks.sol: Amid the chaos, Mu Song raised his head, his heart pounding harder and louder than the drums echoing around him.

hunks.baseline: Beyond the fog slowly dispersing along the bow of the fast ship were a shattered ferry landing and countless corpses filling the river.
hunks.sol: Beyond the fog parting before the bow of the swift ship lay a shattered ferry landing and countless corpses filling the river.

hunks.baseline: “What the fucking hell…!”
hunks.sol: “What the fuck…!”

hunks.baseline: Maybe they were too distracted to care. Or maybe I had simply said what they all wanted to say.
hunks.sol: Maybe they were too overwhelmed to care. Or maybe I had simply said what they all wanted to say.

hunks.baseline: “This is nothing short of hell.”
hunks.sol: “This is a hellscape.”

hunks.baseline: “...How could this happen?”
hunks.sol: “…How could this happen?”

hunks.baseline: Jeok Cheongang muttered in a deeply subdued voice, while Cheongpung, who was usually so cheerful, looked around with trembling eyes.
hunks.sol: Jeok Cheongang muttered in a grim, subdued voice, while the usually cheerful Cheongpung looked around with trembling eyes.

hunks.baseline: The bodies we had seen around the ferry landing were only a fraction of the countless deaths that had descended upon the island.
hunks.sol: The bodies we had seen around the ferry landing were only a fraction of the dead scattered across the island.

hunks.baseline: I forced myself to ignore Hyuk Mujin, who was calling to me in a trembling voice.
hunks.sol: I forced myself to ignore Hyuk Mujin’s trembling voice.

hunks.baseline: I already knew what was in the direction he was pointing. My teeth clenched before I even realized it.
hunks.sol: I had already seen what he was pointing at. My teeth clenched before I even realized it.

hunks.baseline: The stronghold’s people had brought their families and blood relatives to this safe, natural fortress, and the people gathered there had formed a village of their own.
hunks.sol: They had brought their families and relatives to this safe, natural fortress, and the people who gathered here had formed a village of their own.

hunks.baseline: Children who had only just been weaned. Frail old people and women. Even the hundreds of river bandits who should have risked their lives to protect them.
hunks.sol: Children who looked as though they had only just been weaned. Frail old people and women. Even the hundreds of river bandits who should have risked their lives to protect them.

hunks.baseline: Every single one of them had died.
hunks.sol: Every single one of them was dead.

hunks.baseline: That was the result after my companions and I, along with the martial artists of Wudang and the Zhuge Clan and the river bandits of Water Dragon Stronghold under Mu Song, had searched every corner of the island for more than half a day.
hunks.sol: That was the conclusion my companions and I had reached after searching every corner of the island for more than half a day, along with the martial artists of Wudang and the Zhuge Clan and the river bandits of Water Dragon Stronghold under Mu Song.

hunks.baseline: Mu Song’s beastlike roar echoed from far away. Gung Gibang muttered in a heavy voice.
hunks.sol: Mu Song’s beastlike roar echoed from far away. Gung Gibang muttered heavily beside me.

hunks.baseline: But that was not true. There was certainly a difference in weight. The weight of a person’s death changed depending on who they had been in life and what relationship they had shared with you.
hunks.sol: But that was not true. There was a difference in weight. A person’s death weighed differently depending on who they had been in life and what relationship they had shared with you.

hunks.baseline: For Mu Song, at least, the Yangtze One Saber Hwang Chung must have been such a person.
hunks.sol: For Mu Song, at least, Yangtze One Saber Hwang Chung must have been such a person.

hunks.baseline: “The Family Head ordered me to escort you to him at once.”
hunks.sol: “The Family Head has ordered me to bring you to him at once.”

hunks.baseline: At the words of the Zhuge Clan martial artist who came running up to us, Jin Wikyung nodded.
hunks.sol: At the words of the Zhuge Clan martial artist who came hurrying toward us, Jin Wikyung nodded.

hunks.baseline: “Yes. Great Hero Hwang’s corpse was just found. However…”
hunks.sol: “Yes. Great Hero Hwang’s body was just found. However…”

hunks.baseline: Without another word, we began walking.
hunks.sol: We set off without another word.

hunks.baseline: Not to mourn his death, but because the dead Yangtze One Saber Hwang Chung was important enough to warrant it.
hunks.sol: Not to mourn Hwang Chung’s death, but because even in death, the Yangtze One Saber was important enough to demand our immediate attention.

hunks.baseline: The reason Jeok Cheongang, the only person among us who had known him, wore such a hard expression was not grief, either.
hunks.sol: Jeok Cheongang was the only one among us who had known him, but grief was not the reason his expression had hardened, either.

hunks.baseline: At the Sound Transmission that suddenly slipped into my ear, I slowed my steps and answered.
hunks.sol: The sudden Sound Transmission slipped into my ear. I slowed my steps and answered.

hunks.baseline: —You know what this old man is thinking?
hunks.sol: —And how do you know what this old man is thinking?

hunks.baseline: —The same thing I am.
hunks.sol: —You’re thinking the same thing I am.

hunks.baseline: —I’m getting an urge to use the Flame Divine Palm.
hunks.sol: —I feel an urge to use the Flame Divine Palm.

hunks.baseline: —I’ve needed to piss since earlier, too, but I’ve been holding it in. You should hold it in as well, Old Master. I’m organizing what I want to say.
hunks.sol: —I’ve needed to piss for a while, too, but I’ve been holding it in. You should hold it in as well, Old Master. I’m still organizing my thoughts.

hunks.baseline: I calmly laid out the thoughts I had been considering over the past half day.
hunks.sol: I calmly laid out what I had been considering over the past half a day.

hunks.baseline: —Donghu Stronghold is a natural fortress that can only be reached by crossing Tianling Falls. I don’t know the details of the situation here, but defeating the Supreme Peak master Hwang Chung and the river bandits under him would be impossible for any ordinary force.
hunks.sol: —Donghu Stronghold is a natural fortress that can only be reached by crossing Tianling Falls. I don’t know every detail of the situation here, but no ordinary force could dream of defeating the Supreme Peak master Hwang Chung and the river bandits under his command.

hunks.baseline: —Even a mongrel gets the upper hand on its own doorstep. To face men who have spent their entire lives on the Yangtze, you would need overwhelming strength.
hunks.sol: —Even a mongrel has the advantage in its own yard. To face men who have spent their entire lives on the Yangtze, you would need overwhelming strength.

hunks.baseline: —The Yangtze One Saber in particular is like a ghost of the water. During the Great Faction War, he achieved overwhelming victories against the Demonic Cult in every naval battle. To wipe out Donghu Stronghold, the attacker would have needed at least twice its forces.
hunks.sol: —The Yangtze One Saber in particular is a veritable water ghost. During the Great Faction War, he won overwhelming victories against the Demonic Cult in every battle fought on water. To wipe out Donghu Stronghold, the attackers would have needed at least twice its strength.

hunks.baseline: Twice the forces of Donghu Stronghold…
hunks.sol: Twice the strength of Donghu Stronghold…

hunks.baseline: I had only realized it after coming here, but Donghu Stronghold was on a scale utterly incomparable to the other water strongholds.
hunks.sol: I had only learned it after coming here, but Donghu Stronghold was far larger than any ordinary water stronghold.

hunks.baseline: The number of corpses discovered so far had already surpassed a thousand. In terms of size alone, it would not have been an exaggeration to call it a faction.
hunks.sol: The number of bodies discovered so far had already surpassed a thousand. In terms of size alone, it would not have been an exaggeration to call it a faction in its own right.

hunks.baseline: *Mu Song said something like that before, too. Donghu Stronghold is the second most powerful water stronghold in the Yangtze River Channel League, after its headquarters.*
hunks.sol: *Mu Song said something like that before, too. Donghu Stronghold is the strongest water stronghold in the Yangtze River Channel League after its headquarters.*

hunks.baseline: I only had to look around to understand.
hunks.sol: One look around was enough to understand why.

hunks.baseline: Everything had been shattered and destroyed, but this one water stronghold had once assembled a fleet of more than fifty ships and built a settlement of homes that would not have looked out of place in a bustling city.
hunks.sol: Everything had been shattered and destroyed, but this one water stronghold had once maintained a fleet of some fifty ships and built a settlement filled with houses that would not have looked out of place in a bustling city.

hunks.baseline: It might not have reached the level of a prestigious great faction such as the Nine Sects and One Gang or the Five Great Families, but the river bandits under the command of the Yangtze One Saber had undoubtedly been highly elite as well.
hunks.sol: It might not have compared to prestigious great factions such as the Nine Sects and One Gang or the Five Great Families, but the river bandits under the Yangtze One Saber must have been formidable elites in their own right.

hunks.baseline: And there were very few groups capable of deploying twice that force against Donghu Stronghold.
hunks.sol: And very few groups could deploy twice that much force against Donghu Stronghold.

hunks.baseline: —If there is a place capable of mobilizing that many men and ships…
hunks.sol: —If we’re talking about places capable of mobilizing that many men and ships…

hunks.baseline: —As far as this old man knows, there are only four such places in Hubei Province. One of them is already practically gone.
hunks.sol: —As far as this old man knows, there are only four in Hubei Province. One of them is already as good as gone.

hunks.baseline: —Correct. But most of the Sea Serpent Society are fishermen and boatmen who gathered for their livelihood, so they have far too few masters. Wudang and the Zhuge Clan possess the strength, but neither has any reason or justification to attack Donghu Stronghold.
hunks.sol: —Correct. But most of the Sea Serpent Society are fishermen and boatmen who banded together for their livelihoods, so they have far too few masters. Wudang and the Zhuge Clan have the strength, but neither has any reason or justification to attack Donghu Stronghold.

hunks.baseline: —Of course. Even a child knows that Murim and the authorities maintain a relationship of mutual noninterference. Even if the Son of Heaven had issued an imperial edict to subjugate the stronghold, they could not have carried it out secretly in a way that deceived the eyes of the entire world.
hunks.sol: —Of course. Even a child knows that Murim and the authorities maintain a relationship of mutual noninterference. Even if the Son of Heaven had issued an imperial edict to subjugate the stronghold, it could never have been carried out this secretly, hidden from the eyes of the entire realm.

hunks.baseline: Murim was a tree rooted deep within the forest that was the world.
hunks.sol: Murim was a tree rooted deep within the forest of the world.

hunks.baseline: It had grown too tall to prune its branches, and anyone who tried to chop it down carelessly would risk damaging the blade of their own ax.
hunks.sol: It had grown too tall to prune, and anyone who tried to chop it down carelessly risked damaging the blade of their own ax instead.

hunks.baseline: That was one of the reasons Murim had survived even though the master of the forest had changed many times.
hunks.sol: That was one of the reasons Murim had endured even though the owner of the forest had changed many times.

hunks.baseline: A massive tree that even the Son of Heaven, the woodcutter, could not easily raise his ax against.
hunks.sol: A towering tree that even the Son of Heaven, the woodcutter, could not easily raise his ax against.

hunks.baseline: That was Murim. The countless branches and leaves that had grown from that great tree had flourished by joining forces—and, at times, by breaking one another.
hunks.sol: That was Murim. The countless branches and leaves that had sprung from this great tree had grown by joining forces—and, at times, by breaking one another.

hunks.baseline: If the water strongholds scattered throughout the world were gathered in one place, they would be more than worthy of being called a great faction, and their number of masters was not far behind that of the Nine Sects and One Gang or the Five Great Families.
hunks.sol: If all the water strongholds scattered across the realm were gathered in one place, they would be a major force in their own right, and the number of masters among them would not fall far behind the Nine Sects and One Gang or the Five Great Families.

hunks.baseline: And now that very branch of the Yangtze River Channel League had been broken.
hunks.sol: And now a branch of the Yangtze River Channel League had been broken.

hunks.baseline: By someone whose identity was unknown.
hunks.sol: By someone whose identity remained unknown.

hunks.baseline: —Do you think the culprit is one of those four places: Wudang, the Zhuge Clan, the authorities, or the Sea Serpent Society?
hunks.sol: —Do you think the culprit is one of those four? Wudang, the Zhuge Clan, the authorities, or the Sea Serpent Society?

hunks.baseline: —This is a waterway crossed by hundreds of ships every day. Avoiding all those eyes while mobilizing enough force to cross Tianling Falls would be… extremely difficult.
hunks.sol: —This waterway sees hundreds of ships pass through every day. Mobilizing enough force to cross Tianling Falls while avoiding all those eyes would be… extremely difficult.

hunks.baseline: I finally let out the words that had been circling the tip of my tongue.
hunks.sol: I finally let out the words that had been hovering on the tip of my tongue.

hunks.baseline: —They had no need to load hundreds or thousands of soldiers onto ships and cross Tianling Falls. If a warp—no, if the formation they call a Moving Formation were hidden somewhere around here, that would explain everything.
hunks.sol: —They had no need to load hundreds or thousands of men onto ships and cross Tianling Falls. If a warp—no, if the formation they call a Moving Formation is hidden somewhere around here, that would explain everything.

hunks.baseline: Dark Heaven had already proved it in Shaolin and Sichuan.
hunks.sol: Dark Heaven had already proved it could be done in Shaolin and Sichuan.

hunks.baseline: If my guess was correct, it would also fully explain how they had gone unnoticed by the countless eyes traveling along the Yangtze.
hunks.sol: If my guess was correct, it would also fully explain how they had gone unnoticed by the countless people traveling along the Yangtze.

hunks.baseline: —So this old man is not the only one who thinks so.
hunks.sol: —So this old man isn’t the only one who thinks so.

hunks.baseline: —In a situation like this, excluding Dark Heaven… the smell is far too damn foul.
hunks.sol: —In a situation like this, we can’t rule out Dark Heaven. It stinks too damn much.

hunks.baseline: I continued speaking as I looked toward the familiar faces slowly approaching from the distance.
hunks.sol: I continued as I watched the familiar faces slowly approaching from the distance.

hunks.baseline: —We’ll have to find that out now.
hunks.sol: —That’s what we need to find out now.
